text_block_list.text:
The prelude to the primary goal, the 
Kikuka Sho. Kitasan Black's autumn 
campaign begins here with the St. Lite 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! The main event is 
3,000m. Today, we start with 2,200m!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Leave acting as your corner second to me!

The distances will get longer from here 
on, so we must gradually get used to them.

And this autumn will likely reveal Kitasan 
Black's aptitude for mid-to-long 
distances, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The prelude to the grand chrysanthemum 
stage! Kitasan Black, ready to give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kitasan Black, you're full of energy. 
But... are you sure you can handle the 
distance?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha, of course it's fine. To tell you 
the truth, this person is...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it she's Sakura Bakushin O's 
disciple. Hmm, no matter how you look at 
it, it just doesn't seem to suit her...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaa--?! How awful! Baseless rumors 
about me are going around!
It wasn't entirely baseless... However...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san. I knew it, longer 
distances really are...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, didn't you say before that you still 
weren't sure...?
choice_data_list: Still, it should probably be fine.
Still, it should probably be fine.

text_block_list.text:
Though not an absolute certainty, I give 
my assessment as a Trainer. I've watched 
Kitasan Black's running and growth 
throughout this entire summer.

Her build, her movements, and her 
footwork. From every angle, she appears 
suited for long distances. Furthermore—

Kitasan Black possesses the mental 
fortitude to endure long distances. Right 
now, expectation far outweighs anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm... going to be fine, aren't I?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see. Even if things went wrong, I wasn't 
planning on giving up. But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you tell me that, Trainer, then I've 
got nothing left to fear!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please, watch me. I can't afford to 
stumble on the first step of autumn. 
Beyond this lies—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Brusquemente-san has gotten even stronger 
and is waiting for me! I'll show her a 
great run without backing down!

—Yes, just up ahead lies that genius. Air 
Groove's greatest, most cherished disciple 
stands waiting.

"With this race, I shall stack yet another 
mountain of effort and press forward with 
immense power."
